html:
Anote Tong was president of Kiribati from 2003 to 2016, when he became the best-known voice in the world for low-lying nations threatened by rising seas.

Kiribati's atolls rise only a few metres above the sea. Tong warned that climate change might make them uninhabitable, and spoke of migration with dignity: training young people for jobs abroad. In 2014 his government bought land on Vanua Levu in Fiji as a food source and possible refuge.

He also closed a huge area of ocean, the Phoenix Islands Protected Area, to commercial fishing. His successors took a different line, but his warnings shaped Pacific diplomacy. See also sea level rise.
sum: Anote Tong was president of Kiribati from 2003 to 2016, when he became the best-known voice in the world for low-lying nations threatened by rising seas.
